lines.zh: 我的鞋尖在地上敲出节拍。
lines.en: My shoe tips tap a rhythm on the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着场子的边线走，数着圈。
lines.en: I walk the ring's edge, counting laps.
My colorful sleeve flaps in the wind.
I skip along as if dancing.
I walk across candy-colored grass.
The laughter arrives before I do.
I walk backwards, watching you the whole time.
The toy city's roads are soft underfoot.

lines.zh: 我每走四步就转一个身。
lines.en: Every four steps, I turn once.
My shadow turns the corner before I do.

lines.zh: 我不走近，近了就不好玩。
lines.en: I keep away; coming close would end the fun.

lines.zh: 我踩爆了一个气球，很响。
lines.en: I step on a balloon and it pops loudly.
I stand here, smiling.
My smile is painted on.
I juggle three balls and drop one.
I pick it up and keep juggling.

lines.zh: 我没有不开心，我什么也感觉不到。
lines.en: I am not unhappy; I feel nothing at all.
The music stopped; I am still dancing.

lines.zh: 我对着空场子鞠了一躬。
lines.en: I bow to an empty field.
My nose squeaks when it is tapped.
The toy city's lights never go out.
I sit on the ground with my legs dangling.
I am counting the audience; there is only you.

lines.zh: 我按了按帽檐，让它遮住眼。
lines.en: I press my brim down to shade my eyes.
I stop halfway through a laugh.
It is far too quiet here; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我把球抛高，等它落回手里。
lines.en: I toss a ball up and wait for it to come back.

lines.zh: 我的脸朝向观众席，那边是空的。
lines.en: My face turns to the seats; they are empty.

lines.zh: 我踩着节拍走动，节拍是我自己的。
lines.en: I walk to a beat that is only mine.

lines.zh: 我把彩带从袖口抽出来，又塞回去。
lines.en: I pull a ribbon from my sleeve and put it back.
You are watching me, and I noticed.
Do not blink; the show is not over.
Your expression is truly interesting.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，帽子响了一声。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you; my hat jingles.
Won't you come a little closer?

lines.zh: 你瞳孔里那个小丑妆花了。
lines.en: The clown in your pupils has smeared paint.
Smile once and I will believe you.

lines.zh: 你的手指在腰后摸索什么。
lines.en: Your fingers are fumbling behind your hip.
I have noted your seat.
Do not leave; the finale has not come yet.
I wave at you, far too broadly.
You retreat, I advance; that is the dance.
You have ruined my makeup.
I am still smiling; that does not mean it does not hurt.
A little of my stuffing leaks out.
The audience will remember that one.
I step back and strike the pose again.
You hit me, so I bow.
My hat is crooked; leave it.

lines.zh: 疼是一种反馈，我收到了。
lines.en: Pain is feedback, and message received.
I paint over the crack.
Hit me again and I change the act.
Do you have candy in your hand?
I do not eat; I only play.
That thing is shiny; let me see it.
You rustle the candy wrapper back and forth.
I do not want food; I want an audience.
Throw it away and I will fetch it.
Is this a gift for me?
I will not take it; I fear it might pop.
You reach out, and so do I.

lines.zh: 玩具有意思，人更有意思。
lines.en: Toys are fun; people are more fun.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我的帽子掉了。
lines.en: You bump me and my hat falls off.
I step back, smiling, and smooth my clothes.
My sleeve brushed against you.
Do not push; I would fall in an ugly way.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两只木偶。
lines.en: We collide like two puppets.
I smell of paint.
You bump me and I spin a full circle.

lines.zh: 我的鞋很硬，你的脚会疼。
lines.en: My shoes are hard; your foot will hurt.
This close, the act falls apart.

lines.zh: 我们又碰了一下，这次是我。
lines.en: We touched again; this time it was me.
Clowns do not pair off.
We meet only on the stage.
My partner was gone last year.
Two perform, and one watches.
I need no one; I have an audience.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会笑，没有心。
lines.en: Our children would laugh without hearts.

lines.zh: 别问我这个，节目里没有。
lines.en: Do not ask me that; it is not in the show.
Every hand I have shaken was cold.
There are no cradles in the toy city.
We are only the same mold, repeated.

lines.zh: 地上一枚玩具硬币，我捡了。
lines.en: A toy coin on the ground; I picked it up.

lines.zh: 我把硬币抛过帽檐再接住。
lines.en: I flip the coin over my hat and catch it.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币是假的，我喜欢。
lines.en: This coin is fake, and I like that.
I pick it up and do a trick.
It slips out of my glove.
I tuck it into my hat.
Anything that falls is a prop.
I gather three and juggle them.
When I bend down, my hat falls off.
This one goes into my box.
You enter the ring, and the show begins.
I raise a hand and hold up one finger.
Do not leave yet; your turn has not come.
I see you, there in the third row.
The distance is right; I begin my act.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就知道你要跑。
lines.en: The moment you move, I know you will run.
My smile opens toward you.
One spectator is enough.
Three, two, one; the lights go down.
The spot you stand on is a good one.

lines.zh: 我在你左边三步，保持着。
lines.en: I keep three steps to your left.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，我的节目在远处。
lines.en: I do not come close; my act works at range.
I raise my hand and my fingertips glow.

lines.zh: 你往哪边躲，我都算好了。
lines.en: Whichever way you dodge, I have it figured.
Do not watch my hands; watch my face.
I am waiting for you to turn around.
My laughter is behind you.
I will not take this step; it is far enough.
The way you raise that shield is comical.
In three seconds, you will go right.
I snap my fingers and light shoots out.
This is not a fist; it is a gift.

lines.zh: 能量束打在你胸口，冒烟。
lines.en: The beam hits your chest and smokes.
You dodged it, so I applaud.
Seven and a half, no more, no less.
I smile as it lands on you.
My glove is a little scorched.
The next shot I aim higher.
Your back to the curtain makes a fine target.
Still screaming means the curtain has not fallen.
The curtain opens and I stand in the middle.

lines.zh: 我从玩具城的箱子里爬出。
lines.en: I climb out of a box in the toy city.
My paint is still wet.
Someone is applauding; actually, no one is.
I open my eyes and practice smiling.

lines.zh: 音乐从很远的地方传来。
lines.en: Music drifts in from very far away.

lines.zh: 追光打过来，我抬手遮眼。
lines.en: The spotlight finds me and I shield my eyes.
This body was stitched together.

lines.zh: 我落地时，鞋跟响了一声。
lines.en: My heels click as I land.

lines.zh: 观众席是空的，我照样演。
lines.en: The seats are empty; I perform anyway.

lines.zh: 我数了三个数，然后出现。
lines.en: I count to three, then appear.

lines.zh: 玩具城又多了一个笑声。
lines.en: The toy city has one more laugh now.

lines.zh: 火把我的纸花烧成了灰。
lines.en: Fire turns my paper flowers to ash.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，关节响得像木偶。
lines.en: I fall and my joints click like a puppet's.

lines.zh: 水把我脸上的妆冲花了。
lines.en: Water washes the paint right off my face.

lines.zh: 炸开的彩纸落了我一身。
lines.en: Blast-scattered confetti rains down all over me.
The arrow passes through my clothes, and no blood comes.

lines.zh: 药水让我的笑歪了一边。
lines.en: The potion makes my smile sag on one side.
I have no stomach, yet I always feel empty.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的脸照得很白。
lines.en: The lightning makes my face look very white.
There is no audience at all in the void.
